onb_welcome_text: Courier helper: it merges parcels and letters/magazines into one checklist per stop and builds your route. Works offline, data stays only on your phone.
onb_base_text: This is your depot — the route start and finish. We'll remember it so you don't retype it. You can change it later in Settings.
install_ios: Safari: Share button → “Add to Home Screen”.
settings_base_hint: Route start and finish. Enter street, house and city.
settings_reset_hint: Restores default settings (depot, theme, language). Stops and index are kept.
settings_clear_confirm: Delete ALL stops and items? This cannot be undone.
import_photo_hint: Photograph the parcel list from the official app, or an address on a letter/magazine.
import_multi_hint: You can shoot the parcel list in several photos — addresses accumulate into one list and duplicates are removed.
import_engine_ready: Engine ready. You can take a photo.
import_no_text: No text recognized. Try another photo.
import_review_hint: Fix only yellow and red rows. Green ones were found in the index.
points_empty: No stops yet. Scan some addresses.
point_delete_confirm: Delete this stop and its items?
route_need_base: Set the Base address in settings first.
route_need_points: No stops with coordinates to route.
route_summary: {n} stops · ~{km} km · starts and ends at Base
install_hint: Add the app to your home screen for offline use.
import_screenshot_tip: Tip: if the official app is on this same phone, take a SCREENSHOT of the list and pick it. A screenshot recognizes far better than a photo of a screen.
import_hint_parcel: PARCELS are a list. Take a SCREENSHOT of the list in the official app and pick it. Several screenshots are fine — addresses accumulate, duplicates are removed.
import_hint_mail: MAGAZINE/LETTER — ONE address each. The camera opens — point it at the mail address.
ocr_key_hint: Paste a free OCR.space key. Without a key a limited demo mode is used.
ocr_cloud_warning: Note: the address image is sent to the OCR.space service (needs internet).
ocr_device_hint: Works offline but recognizes worse. For photos/screenshots prefer Cloud.
import_manual_hint: If a photo won't work, type the address or dictate it. It joins the same review list.
voice_unsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
voice_error: Voice recognition error. Check the mic and internet.
settings_geocode_hint: Finds address coordinates via OpenStreetMap when no local index. Needs internet; the address is sent to the map service.
settings_routemetric_hint: “By roads” uses real driving distances (accurate, needs internet). “Straight-line” is offline and faster.
settings_priority_hint: Parcels are delivered before letters/magazines on near-ties. If mail is clearly closer, mail still goes first — no big detours for a parcel.
